subject.title: fix(agents): hard-deadline runtime auth refresh to prevent gateway deadlock

question: Should OpenClaw accept the 150s OAuth held-lock deadline and 360s runtime-auth deadline as the default auth recovery behavior for hung provider/keychain/lock work?
rationale: The patch appears correct, but it changes credential refresh and runtime auth failure semantics on a security-sensitive provider boundary where CI cannot decide the intended operational policy.

options.title: Accept deadlines after auth/security signoff
options.body: Merge once the auth/security owner confirms the budgets and abandoned-work semantics are acceptable for existing providers.

options.title: Hold for broader live soak
options.body: Pause landing until maintainers collect more long-running gateway/provider evidence around abandoned provider-hook behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept deadlines after auth/security signoff
